b: Hi friends. After my 4 year old was discharged from the hospital 3 days ago for seizures, I am hanging on by a thread 🥲. I finally got a letter from DHS about our food benefits that I have been waiting for WEEKS. I was denied for making $34 over the income guidelines.

After paying to keep the roof over our heads so we don’t end up back in the shelter, paying for two of his new seizure meds ( waiting on an appeal from Medicaid) and my power bill , I am left with $12.83. I need ideas on how I can make this stretch until Sunday when our local food bank opens up. I’m exhausted just trying to survive everyday life while trying to just protect my babies.

I have fought extremely hard to get us out of the shelter, having a job ( with benefits) and getting us a stable place to live after leaving their father all by myself!! I REFUSE to go back down that road or start over again . Please leave me all the ideas on what I can do or make for my boys. Thanks guys!
